insights.one_liner: The University of Twente is a technical university in Enschede with about 3,300 staff and 12,000+ students, posting English-language research jobs with pay shown.

culture.text: Some 3,300 scientists and other professionals working on research and teaching for more than 12,000 students; motto 'High tech, human touch'.
Staff mostly have mechanical engineering, computer science, electrical engineering or psychology backgrounds.
The Faculty of Engineering Technology works on maintenance, smart manufacturing, health technology, resilience and sustainable production.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor under this name.
All 3 current jobs in Enschede (research and data) don't require Dutch, and all show pay.

worth_knowing.text: Encourages students and staff to develop an entrepreneurial spirit.
